title: Bellbrook Hardened Submission Package
availability_notes: The one document in this batch whose account of the May 2025 meeting is NOT corroborated: claims Resolution 2025.79 (extending meeting hours) and Resolution 2025.80 (passed 9/0, directing investigation of Level 1 management options and a report back by October) plus a defeated 2/7 amendment. Per operator's own note (2026-08-22), earlier-authored case material should be treated with more scrutiny, not less; this document reads as an earlier, more aggressive draft than the harm/accountability record and formal complaint letters that followed it. Also spells the community representative's surname "Hodgkinson," inconsistent with "Hodgson" used in every other document and in SRC-0001. See CTR-0001, Q-0001.
